seo_title: SELF — visas and study abroad from Bishkek | SelfVisa & SelfAcademy
seo_description: Visas to the USA, Europe, China, Korea, Japan and Canada. University admission in Korea, the USA, France, Italy, Malaysia and China. Office in Bishkek.
hero_title: Visas and study abroad — **without the guesswork**
hero_subtitle: We prepare visa documents, complete application forms, choose the right university and support you until the visa is issued and you are enrolled.
visa_text: Tourist, visitor, business and student visas. We complete forms, assemble the document package and prepare you for the interview.
study_text: Language courses, bachelor’s and master’s degrees. University selection, documents, scholarships and the student visa.
about_text:
SELF brings together two services: **SelfVisa** — visa consulting, and **SelfAcademy** — education abroad.

We work with citizens of Kyrgyzstan and other Central Asian countries: we review your situation, give an honest assessment, prepare documents and explain every step. The visa decision is made by the embassy — our job is to make sure your application is complete, accurate and consistent.

advantages.title: Error-free forms
advantages.text: DS-160, DS-5535, I-134, Schengen and Asian visa forms — completed and cross-checked against your documents.

advantages.title: Interview preparation
advantages.text: We go through typical consular questions and help you explain the purpose of your trip with confidence.

advantages.title: End-to-end admission
advantages.text: Program selection, motivation letters, scholarships, enrollment and the student visa.

advantages.title: Transparent
advantages.text: We tell you upfront what is included, what it costs and which timelines are realistic.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We discuss your goal, documents and timeline, and give an honest assessment.

steps.title: Documents
steps.text: You get an exact checklist; we review every document and complete the forms.

steps.title: Submission
steps.text: We book your submission or interview and prepare you for the questions.

steps.title: Result
steps.text: We stay in touch until the visa is issued or you are enrolled.

reviews.text: A huge thank you to SelfViza for helping me get a U.S. visa. Special thanks to Ibrahim—he’s very professional. I’d also like to thank Ayim. I wish you continued success in your work and many more grateful visa recipients.

reviews.name: Dinara Mamyrova
reviews.text: This isn’t the first time we’ve turned to Self Visa, and we’ve always received great assistance. This time, with their help, my daughter was admitted to a university in Korea. A special thank you to Nursultan—he was always available, explained everything, and helped us every step of the way. That was very important to us. Thank you so much! ❤️

reviews.name: Nurali Ulanovv
reviews.text: Everything was handled professionally and flawlessly—I started in May, finished, and was admitted by July. They’re always available to provide feedback; they’ll answer any questions at any time and help resolve any issues that come up during the admissions process. Everything moves very quickly—you don’t have to wait for months like you do with other companies. A huge thank you to Nursultan for helping with everything—thank you so much.

reviews.name: Saltanat Beishenova
reviews.text: This is the second time I’ve used Self’s services. They helped me secure urgent appointments at the VFS visa center for Hungary, since it’s practically impossible to get an appointment there on my own for the next two months. A special thanks to Ibrahim for his help and constant communication. I booked an urgent appointment both online and in person, and both times everything went quickly and without any problems.

reviews.name: Beksultan Bapanov

The team helped me gather all the documents, explained the process in detail, and were always available. You can tell they’re professionals. Thanks for the help—I recommend them to anyone who wants to get a visa without any unnecessary stress!

reviews.name: Lili Emman

reviews.name: Altysha E

faq.a: No. Only the embassy or consulate makes the decision, and no honest agency can guarantee it. We guarantee a well-prepared application and thorough interview preparation.

faq.q: Can I get a consultation online?
faq.a: Yes. Message us on WhatsApp — we consult online in Russian, Kyrgyz and English.

faq.q: How much do your services cost?
faq.a: It depends on the country and the type of visa or study program. Message us and we will quote an exact price after a short consultation.

faq.q: Do you work with citizens of other countries?
faq.a: Yes, we advise citizens of Kyrgyzstan and other Central Asian countries. Requirements depend on citizenship — we will clarify during the consultation.

form_text: Leave your contacts and choose a destination — the request opens in WhatsApp. We reply during working hours.
